item.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Jed the Heartbreaker
item.description: Mrs. Drysdale is tired of the Clampetts, especially Granny, who keeps scraping with her. When Miss Jane tells her of a beautiful movie starlet who threw herself at Jed and how Jed stopped going to his movie studio when he found out she was married, she plans a scheme herself. Mrs. Drysdale decides to throw herself at Jed to get him and his family to move away from Beverly Hills.

item.title: The Brady Bunch - The Teeter-Totter Caper
item.description: When Bobby and Cindy are not invited to a wedding because they're too young, they set out to do something important. Their goal, break a teeter-totter record. As the rest of the family takes their attempts lightly, news reporters make a visit to the Brady household to report on their efforts. Meanwhile, Carol attempts to buy the perfect wedding gift for her cousin, Gertrude.

item.title: The Brady Bunch - The Not-So-Rose-Colored Glasses
item.description: Jan needs glasses but doesn't want to wear them because of how they make her look — until she has an accident that destroys Mike's surprise anniversary gift to Carol, a framed portrait of the Brady kids.

item.title: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom - Winter in the Wild Kingdom
item.description: "Bulldogging elk from helicopters in the snow-covered Colorado mountains highlights a trip to the wild kingdom in winter."

item.title: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom - Land of the Shadows
item.description: "Deep in the forest of South America Marlin and Jim journey through this twilight world to observe the many strange and beautiful creatures that inhabit this primitive forest."

item.title: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom - Challenge to Survival
item.description: "As civilization moves step by step into the wild kingdom, all forms of wildlife are forced to retreat until in many cases their survival is challenged. Man must meet this challenge and help animals survive. In this episode, man finds excitement and action as he captures, tags and relocated animals all over the world."

item.title: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom - Okavango
item.description: "The Okavango, a vast area of swamp and sand is a haven for many animals of Africa. Marlin and Jim explore this luxuriant oasis that’s alive with animal activity."

item.title: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom - Killers of the Rupununi
item.description: "Deep in the interior of British Guiana roam the big cats of South America…the jaguar, cougar, margay, ocelot and the jaguarundi. Marlin and Jim journey by canoe and horseback to get a closer look at these killer cats in action."

item.title: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom - In Search of a Whale
item.description: "Marlin and Jim spend weeks traversing the Southern California Coast in search of a whale."

item.title: The Life and Times of Grizzly Adams - The World's Greatest Bounty Hunter
item.description: "After coming down with a seriously high fever and sickness,Mad Jack's state of mind leads him to believe he's a bounty hunter. He also believes that Adams is the man he's looking to hunt down and take in...dead or alive."
